note: failures and successes are published side by side; a refuted prediction carries the exact claim text it retires

entries.label: [REGISTERED LAW, LITERAL APPLICATION]
entries.prediction: T01_GMI: lambda* = eta*p/2 selects the property class correctly in every world
entries.evidence: 108 of 324 E-SKEW worlds mispredicted; first witness q=1/5, p=2/5, eta=1, lambda=3/25 -> predicted PERSISTENT_STATE, declared accounting selects STATELESS

claim_ceiling_change.retired: lambda* = eta*p/2 stated without an input-distribution qualifier
claim_ceiling_change.replacement: lambda* = eta*p*R0 where R0 is the minimum delayed-channel error rate attainable without state under the environment's input law; eta*p/2 is the uniform-input case only

entries.related_independent_finding: research/gmi-833-z-z5-critical-phenomena-v1 SP-3/SP-4 found the same law is the A=2 case of lambda*(A) = eta*p*(1-1/A) in alphabet size; input skew is a second, independent dimension and both are instances of lambda* = eta*p*R0

entries.label: [DERIVED-AT-FREEZE]
entries.prediction: D7: the repaired law lambda*(q) = eta*p*min(q,1-q) is correct on R1 in every E-SKEW world
entries.evidence: 324 of 324 E-SKEW worlds correct, 12 of them exact ties called as ties; also 60/60 E-LIN and 20/20 E-COD under the same mechanism reading

entries.label: [FROZEN HYPOTHESIS]
entries.prediction: D1: T02..T08 agree with T01_GMI on R1 in all 404 worlds (observational equivalence at the flagship resolution)
entries.evidence: 108 R1 disagreements each -- exactly the E-SKEW worlds where the registered closed form is wrong and the declared-cost parents are right
entries.consequence: the equivalence statement of row 6 attaches to the REPAIRED law, not to the registered closed form; D12 verifies 0 disagreements there across all 404 worlds

entries.label: [FROZEN HYPOTHESIS]
entries.prediction: D2: at least one of T02..T08 disagrees with T01_GMI on the finer readout R2 in at least one world
entries.evidence: all seven reproduce the declared-cost argmin set in all 404 worlds; 0 R2 mismatches each. The finer readout does not separate them either.

entries.label: [FROZEN HYPOTHESIS]
entries.prediction: D3/D4/D11: MDL, the folk Occam rule and SRM each disagree with the registered law on E-LIN and are adjudicated wrong there
entries.evidence: each loses exactly 40 of 60 E-LIN worlds; MDL is correct on all 20 E-COD worlds, the control that shows the failure is environment-relative

entries.label: [PARENT NEGATIVE CONTROL]
entries.prediction: the deliberately shifted boundary 2*lambda*, the registered negative control of the parent transition package
entries.evidence: 40 of 60 E-LIN worlds and 252 of 324 E-SKEW worlds mispredicted
